'''Flarevix''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Firefox]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Phantifox]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "You'd think more tails means more room to hide snacks, but now that everyone's watching, Flarevix just has to share the stash."

Flarevix is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A nine-tailed fox with a poppy red and off-white color palette. The tips of its ears, paws, and its hind legs are black. Its eyes appear to be perpetually shut and it has teardrop-shaped eyebrows. It's also sitting upright and has a fluffy chest.

Flarevix's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with light blue, off-white with pure white, and black with blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Flarevix's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Phantifox]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 20,000 energy drinks.
* Own 24-star Fire Tatari x3.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Don't ask me if a nine-tailed fox is real. I don't even know where the universe ends and begins."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Flarevix's tail detects changes in emotion and is often used by trainers to gauge intentions. Strongly dislikes having disheveled fur."
